<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Empty Cow 96</title>
<style>
/* Empty Cow 96 by rrr63 — https://uiverse.io/rrr63/empty-cow-96 */
.button {
  font-size: 17px;
  padding: 15px 35px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  outline: 2px solid #2835ba;
  outline-offset: 0px;
  background: #2835ba;
  border: 0;
  font-weight: bolder;
  color: white;
  transition: all .1s ease-in-out;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
  outline-offset: 3px;
  outline: 3px solid #2835ba;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Hover me !
</button>

</body>
</html>
